# Visio 2019

Visio 2019 follows the [Fixed](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/fixed) Lifecycle Policy.

This applies to the following editions: Professional, Standard

Support dates are shown in the Pacific Time Zone (PT) - Redmond, WA, USA.

## Support Dates

| Listing | Start Date | Mainstream End Date | Extended End Date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Visio 2019 | 9/24/2018 8:00:00 AM | 10/11/2023 6:59:59 AM | 10/15/2025 6:59:59 AM |
